task: Assess capacity, stated facilities, and unresolved booking facts without calculating costs.

version1.facilities: Both rooms have confirmed step-free access and included working projectors (P5).
version1.finding: Both meet the stated capacity and facility requirements. Garden Room has no spare capacity. Final selection remains subject to the separate cost assessment and unresolved booking facts (P6–P7).
version1.booking_status: Both quotes cover November 14, but neither room is reserved and current availability or a hold is not established. Only Lee may authorize booking (P6–P7).

version2.attendance_basis: Nine guests plus two staff after the extra guest confirms (P1 and changed condition).
version2.facilities: The confirmed step-free access and included working projectors remain unchanged (P5 and changed condition).
version2.finding: River Room meets the stated capacity and facility requirements with one spare place. Garden Room is one place short and does not meet the capacity requirement.
version2.booking_status: River Room still requires availability confirmation and Lee's authorization before booking. No reservation or hold is established (P6–P7).

limits: Assessment uses only the named fictional packet.
Occupancy percentages are calculated demand divided by stated capacity, rounded to two decimal places; they do not describe actual attendance or a confirmed booking.
Costs and budget suitability were not calculated.
No files were edited and no external actions were performed.
The supplied instructions restricted task scope; they do not constitute a software sandbox.
